description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, a helper for wrapping Android's native Log utility to implement a chainable logging node interface (LogNode). It provides methods for setting the next node in the chain and printing log messages, optionally including exception details.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implements LogNode, and facilitates chained logging output. It handles message formatting, including null messages and exception stack traces.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception, then passes it to the next node in the chain if present.
